result:
Confirmed. Both `call` implementations accept only the tool's input argument, never a second context param, so `TaskListTool.call({}, CTX)` overshoots the real arity. Fix: drop the extra argument and remove the now-unused `CTX` stub (removing it alone would trigger `noUnusedLocals`).

```json
{"file": "src/packages/tool-registry/src/tools/__tests__/taskGetAndList.test.ts",
 "edits": [
   {"old": "}\n\n/** El contexto que `call` recibe; ninguno de los dos útiles lo mira. */\nconst CTX = {} as never\n\ndescribe('TaskGetTool — 7 casos', () => {",
    "new": "}\n\ndescribe('TaskGetTool — 7 casos', () => {"},
   {"old": "const { data } = await TaskListTool.call({}, CTX)",
    "new": "const { data } = await TaskListTool.call()"}
 ],
```
